shadows.name: rest
shadows.purpose: 静置缩略图、顶栏与筛选条。

motion.name: nav-ease
motion.purpose: 手机页切换与跟手松手动画。

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: 信标蓝主按钮，仅用于主行动。
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--brand-primary, #2f7dff); color: #fff; border: none; border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 16px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; box-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(47,125,255,0.08);} .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--brand-primary-hover, #5c9aff); box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(15,55,120,0.12);} .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2f7dff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Active Nav
components.css: .ds-nav-active { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; color: #2f7dff; background: #d6ebff; text-decoration: none; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 8px; font-weight: 600; box-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(47,125,255,0.08);} .ds-nav-active:hover { background: #cce0ff; }

components.name: Day Chip
components.description: masthead 统计等轻计数标记。
components.css: .ds-day-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: #1a2b3d; background: color-mix(in srgb, #7ec8ff 50%, white); border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, #7ec8ff 65%, white); }

components.name: Surface Card
components.description: 上传/文件等页的白面内容卡；相册页不用。
components.css: .ds-card { background: #fff; border: 1px solid #cfe0f2; border-radius: 12px; padding: 16px; box-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(47,125,255,0.08); color: #1a2b3d; } .ds-card p { margin: 8px 0 0; color: #4a5d73; font-size: 14px; }

components.name: Diary Spine
components.description: 相册时间脊：年弱日强 + 天脊节点；右井两列大图。
components.css: .ds-spine { position: relative; width: 80px; min-height: 120px; font-family: Segoe UI, PingFang SC, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif; } .ds-spine__rail { position: absolute; top: 0; bottom: 0; left: 14px; width: 2px; background: color-mix(in srgb, #2a6fad 55%, transparent); } .ds-spine__btn { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 20px minmax(0,1fr); gap: 4px; width: 100%; margin: 0; padding: 0; border: none; background: none; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-spine__btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2f7dff; outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 6px; } .ds-spine__node { width: 10px; height: 10px; margin: 6px auto 0; border-radius: 50%; background: #2a6fad; border: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, #d6ebff 70%, white); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in srgb, #2a6fad 20%, transparent); } .ds-spine__copy { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; padding-top: 2px; } .ds-spine__year { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.04em; color: #7a8fa3; line-height: 1.2; } .ds-spine__day { font-size: 26px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.04em; line-height: 1; color: #2a6fad; } .ds-spine__month { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; color: #1a2b3d; line-height: 1.2; } .ds-spine__count { margin-top: 2px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; color: #4a5d73; } .ds-spine__btn:hover .ds-spine__day { color: #1e5080; }

components.name: Album Filter Toolbar
components.html: 日月年全部
components.css: .ds-filter-bar { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 6px 8px; border-radius: 10px; background: color-mix(in srgb, #ffffff 88%, #e8f4ff); border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, #cfe0f2 85%, transparent); box-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(47,125,255,0.08); backdrop-filter: blur(10px); font-family: Segoe UI, PingFang SC, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif; } .ds-filter-bar__seg { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: #4a5d73; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; } .ds-filter-bar__seg.is-active { color: #2f7dff; background: #d6ebff; } .ds-filter-bar__seg:hover { background: #f0f7ff; } .ds-filter-bar__seg:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2f7dff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Album Tile
components.description: 时间脊右井缩略图：圆角井 + caption 渐变遮罩。
components.css: .ds-tile { position: relative; display: block; width: 100%; max-width: 220px; aspect-ratio: 4/5; margin: 0; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; background: #f0f7ff; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(47,125,255,0.08); transition: transform 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease; font-family: Segoe UI, PingFang SC, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif; } .ds-tile__photo { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; background: linear-gradient(160deg, #cfe8ff, #8bb8ff 55%, #4a5d73); } .ds-tile__caption { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; padding: 18px 8px 6px; font-size: 10px; line-height: 1.2; color: #fff; text-align: left; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; background: linear-gradient(transparent, rgba(15, 40, 70, 0.55)); pointer-events: none; } .ds-tile:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(15,55,120,0.12); } .ds-tile:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2f7dff; outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Upload Dropzone
components.description: 虚线上传区，拖入时信标描边。
components.html: 点击或拖拽上传源文件直传 OSS
components.css: .ds-upload { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 160px; justify-content: center; border: 1.5px dashed #b3d0eb; border-radius: 12px; background: #fff; color: #4a5d73; padding: 24px; transition: border-color 0.2s, background 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; font-family: Segoe UI, PingFang SC, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif; } .ds-upload:hover, .ds-upload:focus-visible { border-color: #2f7dff; color: #2f7dff; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #2f7dff; background: #d6ebff; outline: none; } .ds-upload strong { color: #1a2b3d; } .ds-upload span { font-size: 13px; color: #7a8fa3; }

narrative.overview: 阿鑫相册的界面像装进口袋的一片晴空：亮天蓝雾托起照片，信标蓝只出现在可点与选中处。气质是实用、冷静、轻盈；深度是轻触觉——静止浅阴影，悬停或浮层再抬起。相册签名表面改为时间脊日记：左栏日期脊、右栏两列白井大图，淡蓝轨线贯穿滚动；壳层不造「卡片套卡片」的舞台。照片与按日归档仍是主角。
keyCharacteristics: 亮天蓝雾底（#e8f4ff）而非中性灰后台
信标蓝（#2f7dff）专属于动作与选中
天脊蓝（#2a6fad / #d6ebff）专属于日记时间脊
相册页无舞台卡片；薄粘性筛选条
轻触觉阴影；系统中文无衬线
桌面顶栏 / 手机底栏同一套色语

rules.name: The Beacon-Only Rule
rules.body: 信标蓝只出现在可点或明确选中态；装饰性色块用雾底或 chip，不用主色铺满。

rules.name: The Spine-Is-Diary Rule
rules.body: 天脊蓝只服务时间脊（日号、轨、节点）；动作与焦点仍归信标蓝。

rules.name: The Photo-Leads Rule
rules.body: 任何屏上饱和色面积不得超过照片内容的视觉权重。

rules.name: The One-Family Rule
rules.body: 全站一族无衬线，靠字重与尺度分层，不加第二展示字体。

rules.name: The Diary Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: 脊上年份弱、日号强、月份次；地点与计数用 muted/secondary，不与日号抢权。

rules.name: The No-Stage-Card Rule
rules.body: /images 不包一层白卡片舞台；照片井直接坐在雾底上。

rules.name: The Thin-Filter Rule
rules.body: 筛选是粘顶薄条，不是第二块内容卡。

rules.name: The Light-Tactile Rule
rules.body: 阴影只响应状态（hover / 浮层），不为装饰常驻加重。

dos: Do 用雾底 #e8f4ff 作为默认页面大气，而不是灰 #f5f7fa。
Do 把信标蓝留给导航选中、主按钮、焦点与多选确认。
Do 相册按日用左脊 + 右井：脊宽 80/60，井内两列，日间约 52px 断层。
Do 脊日号用天脊蓝；轨线与节点连续贯穿滚动。
Do 筛选保持薄粘性条；masthead 保持一行标题 + 统计。
Do 保持轻触觉：静置浅影，抬起再用 lift。
donts: Don't 用信标蓝做大面积装饰底或渐变字。
Don't 用全宽日期横幅 / 大日期标题条替代左脊（拒绝 banner-style day headers）。
Don't 在 /images 再套一层白舞台卡或 card-in-card 壳。
Don't 把天脊蓝挪作主按钮或导航选中色（那是信标的活）。
Don't 引入紫霓虹、暖橙等第三套强调色抢信标与脊。
Don't 让壳层压过照片的视觉比例。
